repos.brief:
**What it does:** A 523-lesson, 20-phase open-source curriculum that teaches AI engineering through Python, TypeScript, Rust, and Julia — each lesson producing a reusable artifact such as a prompt, agent, or MCP server.

**Why now:** The repo gained 35,000+ stars in a single week, signaling a sharp spike in community attention that makes it a live reference for what the builder ecosystem is collectively studying right now.

**Build with it:** Follow the MCP server lessons to wire a working Model Context Protocol server and deploy it to the ChatGPT or Claude marketplace using the NitroStack integration already documented in the repo.

**What it does:** HyperFrames is an open-source TypeScript framework that converts HTML, CSS, and seekable animations into deterministic MP4 videos via Chrome's BeginFrame API, driven locally by CLI or through AI coding agents using skills.

**Why now:** The repo gained 32,570 stars this week and surfaced on Hacker News as a Show HN, signaling a sharp spike in builder attention after its agent-native workflow went public.

**Build with it:** Run `claude plugin marketplace add heygen-com/hyperframes` in Claude Code and invoke `/hyperframes` to let the agent write, lint, preview, and render an MP4 directly from HTML.

**What it does:** Scrapling is a Python web scraping framework that handles single requests through full-scale crawls, with adaptive element tracking, stealth fetching via Playwright, and an MCP server interface.

**Why now:** The repo gained 24,125 stars this week and surfaced on Hacker News, signaling a sharp spike in community attention worth riding.

**Build with it:** Wire Scrapling's MCP server into a Claude or compatible AI agent to let it autonomously scrape and extract structured data from target sites without writing custom selectors.

**What it does:** A 667-entry evidence-based life-optimization guide for mainland China covering longevity, frugality, legal pitfalls, social insurance, and entrepreneurship compliance, with each entry citing cost, benefit, and source quality (journal papers or official documents).

**Why now:** The repo gained 3,091 stars this week, signaling a sharp spike in discovery, and community forks have already produced translated versions in English, Russian, Spanish, Portuguese, and Vietnamese alongside derivative tools like a WeChat mini-program.

**Build with it:** Drop the provided Claude Code or Codex skill config (in `skills/life-decision-guide/`) into your AI assistant so it queries the book's entries before answering life-decision questions and returns citations by section and item number.

**What it does:** REA is a TypeScript MCP server that connects AI agents to reverse-engineering tools (Hopper, Ghidra, static JS analysis) so they can inspect native binaries, Electron apps, and .NET assemblies without source code.

**Why now:** The repo gained nearly 2,900 stars this week, signaling a rapid surge of builder interest aligned with growing MCP ecosystem adoption.

**Build with it:** Run `npx rea-agents setup`, point it at an existing Ghidra installation, and wire it into Claude or another MCP-compatible agent to let the agent decompile and explain binary features on demand.

**What it does:** Odysseus is a self-hosted, Docker-deployed AI workspace combining chat, agents, deep research, email (IMAP/SMTP), documents, notes, and calendar into one Python app with local and API model support.

**Why now:** The repo gained 1,817 stars this week, signaling a sharp spike in community discovery and likely active first-install traffic worth catching early.

**Build with it:** Clone the repo, wire in an IMAP/SMTP account via `.env`, and use the Email triage + reply-draft workflow as a self-hosted alternative to managed AI email tools.

**What it does:** universal-modder gives any AI coding agent (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Copilot) a shared set of skills, tools, and a knowledge base to find, reverse-engineer, mod, and test almost any PC game you own, with fal-generated art, 3D, and audio built in.

**Why now:** The repo gained 1,507 stars this week, coinciding with a wave of agentic coding tool launches that make agent plugin ecosystems newly practical, and the README explicitly names Claude Code plugin marketplace support as a first-class install path.

**Build with it:** Run `/plugin marketplace add rehan-remade/universal-modder` in Claude Code, set `FAL_KEY`, and prompt the agent to add a weapon or new unit to a game you own — the skills handle recon, asset generation via `um fal`, and in-game testing without additional configuration.

**What it does:** Impeccable is a design-guidance layer for AI coding agents that installs a 24-command vocabulary (`/impeccable audit`, `polish`, `bolder`, etc.) plus 60 deterministic, no-API detector rules to catch common AI frontend tells like Inter-for-everything and purple-to-blue gradients.

**Why now:** The repo crossed 77K stars with 1,495 added this week, signaling a sharp spike in builder interest likely tied to growing frustration with homogeneous AI-generated UIs as vibe-coded projects hit shipping gates.

**Build with it:** Run `npx impeccable install` in an existing Cursor or Claude project, then call `/impeccable audit` on a specific page name to immediately surface deterministic design-quality failures without an API key.

**What it does:** VibeWise is a Claude Code plugin that intercepts implementation to ask for your design approach first, walks through tradeoffs, then writes the code and explains every change — keeping the developer in the decision loop.

**Why now:** The repo jumped 1,486 stars this week and has cleared Anthropic's Claude directory approval, landing just as Claude Code's plugin marketplace becomes a serious distribution channel for developer tooling.

**Build with it:** Install via `/plugin marketplace add nykooi1/vibe-wise` in Claude Code, run `/vibe-wise:learn`, and use it on an existing repo to get Claude's auto-generated system map as a starting point for design-first conversations.

**What it does:** Archify is a JavaScript agent skill for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and OpenCode that converts a natural-language description of any idea, codebase, or plan into a self-contained interactive HTML diagram.

**Why now:** The repo gained 1,415 stars this week and crossed 130K installs on skills.sh, signaling rapid adoption as agent-skill ecosystems around Claude Code and Codex CLI mature.

**Build with it:** Install it as a Claude Code skill, then prompt it with your repo path to generate a navigable architecture diagram with source links in a single agent run.
